title: DS Meshil Maring — portfolio profile
content:
# DS Meshil Maring

Role: Full-Stack Developer & AI Application Engineer.
Intro: I design and develop scalable web applications, secure backend systems, and intelligent AI solutions — turning complex problems into reliable digital products.
Availability: Open to opportunities & freelance collaborations.

## About
I'm a Computer Science Engineering student specializing in Data Science and Machine Learning, with hands-on experience building full-stack applications, backend systems, and AI-powered solutions. I enjoy solving practical problems, creating scalable architectures, and turning ambitious ideas into dependable products.

Education: Bachelor of Technology in Computer Science Engineering, Quest Group of Institutions, Punjab — specialization in Data Science and Machine Learning. Areas: Data Structures and Algorithms, Database Management Systems, Machine Learning, Statistics, Computer Vision, Linear Algebra.

## Contact
Email: hello@example.com. Whether you're hiring a software engineer or planning your next digital product, he'd be happy to connect and discuss how we can work together.
How to start a project: share what you're building, key features or the problem to solve, timeline and rough budget range, and links to references/specs.
Project types he takes on: Full-Stack Web Application, AI / RAG Solution, Backend & APIs, Dashboard & CMS, Something else.
Socials: Email (mailto:hello@example.com), LinkedIn (https://linkedin.com/in/your-handle), GitHub (https://github.com/meshil-maring).

title: Projects
content:
# Projects

## College AI Assistant (In Progress — Featured Case Study)
Multi-tenant RAG platform for university workflows, semantic document retrieval, and personalized academic assistance.
Highlights: Document ingestion, Text chunking, Embeddings, Semantic retrieval, Role-based authorization, Multi-tenant architecture, Academic workflows, Secure data handling.
Stack: React, TypeScript, FastAPI, RAG, PostgreSQL. Note: Currently under development.

## EPM Staffing Services (Live — Recruitment Platform)
Full-stack hiring platform with job postings, candidate tracking, interview scheduling, and role-based authorization.
Highlights: Candidate management, Job management, Interview workflows, Role-based authorization, Backend APIs, Database integration.
Stack: React, Express, PostgreSQL.

## ProjectG (Live — Non-Profit Platform)
CMS and engagement platform with secure administration, content workflows, file storage, and production deployment.
Highlights: Content management, Administrative dashboards, Media handling, Secure backend APIs, Deployment infrastructure.
Stack: TypeScript, Prisma, Docker.

title: Services
content:
# Services

01 — Full-Stack Web Applications: Responsive frontend interfaces, backend services, databases, and complete business workflows. Stack: React, Node.js, Tailwind CSS, PostgreSQL, Firebase, MongoDB.

02 — AI and RAG Solutions: Document-aware assistants, semantic search, LLM integrations, and intelligent retrieval workflows. Stack: Python, FastAPI, Hugging Face, PostgreSQL, Supabase, React.

03 — Backend and API Development: REST APIs, secure authentication, role-based authorization, database integration, and multi-tenant architecture. Stack: Node.js, Python, FastAPI, Docker, PostgreSQL, Supabase.

04 — Dashboards and CMS Platforms: Custom admin dashboards, content management systems, media workflows, and operational interfaces. Stack: React, Tailwind CSS, PostgreSQL, Supabase, MongoDB, Firebase.

title: How he works (process)
content:
# How he works

01 Understand — Clarify the problem, user needs, and project requirements.
02 Plan & Design — Map user flows and design clear, intuitive interfaces.
03 Architecture & Database — When needed, plan the application structure, APIs, and database schema to support the project's features.
04 Develop — Build the interface, implement backend logic, and connect the application's components.
05 Test & Refine — Check functionality, responsiveness, and usability, then refine the experience.
06 Deploy & Improve — Launch the project, document the setup, and refine it based on feedback.
